requirements.requirement: Write a paper that adapts AI Co-Scientist, AI Scientist-v2, AlphaEvolve/OpenEvolve into a distinct Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3 method.
requirements.gap: The method synthesis is documented, but the paper remains a pilot/evidence-package draft rather than a final top-conference submission.
requirements.next_action: Keep method naming centered on IGRE and remove any residual wording that sounds like a pasted combination of prior papers.

requirements.requirement: Design human participation nodes at creative and key decision points.
requirements.gap: The gates are specified and logged, but large-scale live human-user traces are not available.
requirements.next_action: Collect multi-researcher co-pilot traces only after ethics/privacy review and real deployment.

requirements.gap: There are runnable smoke and matched-budget traces, but not enough full-scale matched tasks/seeds for a broad superiority claim.
requirements.next_action: Run at least 5 matched-budget pairs per task across at least 3 tasks before claiming performance improvement.

requirements.requirement: Use AlphaEvolve/OpenEvolve-style deep search on automatically evaluable subproblems.
requirements.gap: The evidence is micro-scale and demonstrates integration, not broad algorithm-discovery superiority.
requirements.next_action: Extend OpenEvolve-style search to more machine-gradeable subproblems with matched baselines.

requirements.requirement: Choose benchmarks based on the paper claim rather than limiting to FML-bench.
requirements.gap: The package considers FML-bench, MLAgentBench, OpenReview, OpenEvolve-style probes, and TFR, but at least one non-FML official benchmark still lacks a complete scored matched comparison.
requirements.next_action: Complete one official non-FML benchmark comparison when data access and setup permit.

requirements.requirement: Emphasize that human participation can be harmful on average but may raise high-tail breakthrough probability through taste and insight.
requirements.gap: The high-tail theory is operationalized, but no positive delayed-value/high-tail case has been demonstrated yet.
requirements.next_action: Prioritize delayed-value replay cases where historical review signals align with later frontier evidence.

requirements.requirement: Show concrete regenerated papers and data for several meaningful OpenReview cases.
requirements.gap: Internal review is positive (3/3 six-gate wins, mean delta 1.133), but it is deterministic internal review rather than human expert review.
requirements.next_action: Use the prepared blind packet for future expert validation; keep current result labeled as internal evidence.

requirements.requirement: Produce English and Chinese paper PDFs.
requirements.gap: PDFs exist and are audited; final camera-ready paper still depends on stronger evidence.
requirements.next_action: Rebuild PDFs after any substantive manuscript revision.

requirements.requirement: Produce English and Chinese usage/runbook documentation.
requirements.gap: Usage is complete for the current package shape.
requirements.next_action: Keep commands synchronized with new experiment scripts.

requirements.requirement: Generate a reusable Codex skill for Co-Pilot AI Scientist v3.
requirements.gap: Skill is packaged and smoke-audited, but broader external reuse is not yet observed.
requirements.next_action: Run the skill on a fresh topic outside this repository when evaluating generality.

requirements.requirement: Push the project to the user's GitHub.
requirements.gap: Branch is pushed if remote branch lookup succeeds; publication as a PR/release is separate.
requirements.next_action: Create a release or PR only when the user wants a public submission package.

requirements.requirement: Run experiments on the SSH-controlled Ubuntu computer where relevant.
requirements.gap: Several Ubuntu traces exist, but some official benchmark attempts hit data/auth/setup blockers.
requirements.next_action: Pre-cache datasets or choose official tasks with open data to complete non-FML scored comparisons.

requirements.requirement: Use Monica-routed GPT/Gemini/Anthropic models when useful for paper quality.
requirements.gap: Model reviews help audit quality but do not count as independent human expert review.
requirements.next_action: Use model reviews for iteration; use human experts only as future supplementary validation.

requirements.requirement: Record author as He Shi, NUS School of Computing undergraduate.
requirements.gap: Author metadata is recorded in the paper package.
requirements.next_action: Keep author information synchronized in any final submission template.

requirements.gap: Current evidence is a strong pilot/reproducibility package, but top-conference empirical sufficiency remains unproven: no independent human expert ratings, limited matched tasks/seeds, and limited full end-to-end trajectories.
requirements.next_action: Treat the next research phase as evidence collection: matched multi-task runs, complete non-FML benchmark, and independent review when feasible.

largest_current_gap: Top-conference empirical sufficiency remains incomplete: the package has auditable artifacts, internal/model reviews, and pilot experiments, but not independent expert ratings, large matched benchmark evidence, or broad multi-researcher online traces.
next_best_action: Run a compact but complete non-FML matched benchmark or a multi-case delayed-value replay before polishing the manuscript further.
claim_boundary: This audit maps objective completion. It does not mark the active goal complete because the original top-conference empirical target is not yet proven.
